evidence.title: Mythos attack on 3rd-round PQC algorithm candidate puts it out of commission

summary: A newly discovered Mythos attack has compromised a leading post-quantum cryptography (PQC) algorithm in the third round of NIST's standardization process, rendering it ineffective. The vulnerability raises concerns about the security of PQC candidates ahead of final selection.
title: Mythos Attack Disables Third-Round Post-Quantum Cryptography Candidate
